newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Rapid sterling gain may not be sustainable - George.
newsitem.headline: Rapid sterling gain may not be sustainable - George.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said the speed of sterling's rise on the currency markets since autumn suggested that the rise might not be sustainable.

"It's very difficult to explain in terms of relative economic conditions in the U.K. and abroad why the exchange rate, in effective terms against a basket of currencies, should have risen by nearly 11 percent since the autumn," George told journalists during a visit to Lisbon.
"That suggests that it might not persist," he said.
